summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature. Changed files: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coordinates) pairs; set_rnd skips __ attributes; docstrings updated), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; PatchDataset docstring np.float -> float; math import removed), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry), and new tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape, test_loading_array, test_missing_len). Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Open items: EXPECTED_PATCHES in test_loading_array is a NaN placeholder, so that test fails until the literal values are filled in from one pytest run; the multi-worker comparison uses no transform because per-worker seeding changes randomized values; the docstring example output is reasoned from the worker split, not executed. Pre-existing lines over 120 characters in utils.py (get_valid_patch_size docstring) were left unchanged.
